recommendation: Keep the fix. It reconciles the old issue to the current path convention, removes the stale bare value path from the active examples page, and avoids reopening adjacent decisions already represented by related issue-reconcile commits.
issue_request: FHIR-8542 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for the extensibility examples. It reported that an extension definition example used ElementDefinition.path "Extension.value", which did not resolve to an actual extension value path, and asked for the example to use "Extension.value[x]"; the Jira comments accepted a typed "Extension.valueUri" correction for the originally cited DSTU1 snippet.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by SVN revision 6255, imported as git commit 9cfcc419fbf519d5ee3dc909563eb9de8b479d54, which changed one Patient Consent example path from "Extension.value" to "Extension.valueUri". The same active examples page still retained a bare "Extension.value" in the Patient Name Parts example and mixed historical typed-suffix spelling with current value[x] examples.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes extensibility-examples.html under the active Extensibility page, so the edited file feeds the current build. Current ElementDefinition.path guidance says polymorphic element paths end in "[x]", and a 2024 implementer Zulip thread about these exact examples concluded that "Extension.value[x]" is best and "Extension.value" is wrong. Related AutoFHIR commits for FHIR-34212 and FHIR-18375 already corrected adjacent URL/cardinality defects on the same page.
reconciliation: Updated the Patient Consent and Patient Name Parts XML and JSON StructureDefinition snippets in source/extensibility-examples.html to use "Extension.value[x]" for extension value ElementDefinition.path entries, while preserving existing type codes and cardinality corrections.
source_changes: source/extensibility-examples.html: changed the Patient Consent XML and JSON StructureDefinition snippets from Extension.valueUri to Extension.value[x] for the extension value path.
source/extensibility-examples.html: changed the Patient Name Parts XML and JSON StructureDefinition snippets from Extension.value to Extension.value[x] for the extension value path.
